slots.name: president trust gap

slots.name: lecture date
slots.sentence: On June 5, the Center on the United States and Europe at Brookings hosted Anna Colin Lebedev for the 21st annual Raymond Aron Lecture .

slots.name: institutional trust rating
slots.sentence: Before 2014, political institutions in Russia and Ukraine consistently received trust ratings below 30%, and sometimes even below 15%, according to opinion polls.
